name: krafty-sprouts/schedulely
label: Schedulely
description: Spreads queued drafts across future publishing windows, with daily quotas, minimum intervals, active weekdays and optional queue ordering. Sends a series' titles, never article text, to the AI service you pick, and only if you turn AI ordering on.
author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC

admin.label: Schedulely
admin.description: Spread queued drafts across publishing windows.

settings.label: Status to schedule from
settings.description: Items in this status are the queue. Draft or In review.

settings.label: Content types to schedule
settings.description: Content type keys, separated by commas, such as post or post, page. Only items of these types join the queue.

settings.label: Posts per day
settings.description: How many items go live in each publishing window.

settings.label: Pool size (most per run)
settings.description: The most queued items one run loads, oldest first. A larger pool gives shuffling and ordering more to work with.

settings.label: Progress batch size
settings.description: How many items a run schedules between progress updates on the Jobs screen.

settings.label: Window opens
settings.description: The time of day posts may start going live, in the site's timezone. 5:00 PM or 17:00.

settings.label: Window closes
settings.description: The time of day it ends. Set it earlier than the opening time for an overnight window, such as 10 PM to 2 AM.

settings.label: Minimum interval
settings.description: The least gap between two posts in Random mode.

settings.label: Active days
settings.description: Posts are only scheduled on these weekdays.

settings.label: Scheduling mode
settings.description: Random looks most natural but can fall short of the quota. Sequential spaces posts perfectly evenly and always meets it. Hybrid splits the window into equal slots and places each post at a random time inside its slot.

settings.label: Safety buffer
settings.description: Nothing is scheduled sooner than this from now.

settings.label: Reorder the queue before scheduling
settings.description: Spaces related items apart instead of letting a series cluster. Runs only when you start a run yourself, never on the automatic schedule. When off, items keep oldest-first order, or the shuffle below.

settings.label: Ordering method
settings.description: PHP ordering is instant, free and needs no service: it groups items by title with the US state removed and spreads each series. AI ordering asks the service below and falls back to PHP if it fails.

settings.label: PHP spacing strategy
settings.description: Even distribution spreads each series across the whole queue. Round-robin takes one item per series per pass, and the biggest series can bunch up at the end.

settings.label: US timezone-aware ordering
settings.description: Publishes each item during its US state's waking hours (7 AM to 11 PM local), found from the title. Needs Random mode.

settings.label: Shuffle before assigning dates
settings.description: Used when reordering is off, and on every automatic run. Randomises which queued items get the next slots instead of oldest-first.

settings.label: AI service
settings.description: Which service AI ordering calls. Only a title-based slug and a number are sent for each item, never article text.

settings.label: AI model
settings.description: The model to ask. Use a fast one that is not a reasoning model.

settings.label: AI service key
settings.description: The service's API key. Stored encrypted, never shown again. Leave empty to keep the saved one.

settings.label: Most items per AI request
settings.description: Teme allows a plugin ten seconds per request, so a bigger queue is ordered with PHP instead.

settings.label: Rotate the acting person
settings.description: Each write is made for a random one of the accounts below. Teme does not say whether that changes an item's author.

settings.label: Accounts to rotate
settings.description: Account IDs, separated by commas or lines.

settings.label: Accounts never used
settings.description: Account IDs left out of the rotation.

settings.label: Account to act as
settings.description: The account ID Schedulely schedules for on the automatic schedule, and the fallback when no rotation is set. Required for automatic runs.

settings.label: Schedule automatically
settings.description: Runs on its own, on the interval below. Off until you turn it on.

settings.label: Automatic run interval
settings.description: How often an automatic run happens.

settings.label: Run now
settings.description: Turn this on and save to start a run at once. To run again, turn it off, save, then on and save.
